caption: About the "Tips" Guide
content:
The "Tips" guide is @b{a reference for logical puzzle-solving techniques}.
@b{It isn't intended to be read from beginning to end.} If you're having trouble with a puzzle, we recommend reading only the sections you need.

@b{Everything you need to know to progress through the game is covered in the "System" and "Rules" guides.}
If you'd rather discover the techniques on your own, you can play through the game without reading the "Tips" guide.

content.caption: Intuition vs. Logic
content: Puzzle-solving approaches can broadly be divided into two types: @b{intuition}, where you find an answer through trial and error, and @b{logic}, where you work toward an answer by building on what you know for certain.

Intuitive approaches are @b{weak when a puzzle has no solution}.
If you try placing tiles at random in an Area that can't yet be completed, failing to find an answer @b{doesn't prove that there isn't one}.

Logical approaches, on the other hand, are @b{strong when a puzzle has no solution}.
If you place only tiles whose positions can be determined with certainty and eventually reach a contradiction, @b{you've proven that there is no solution}.
